name: vless-vps
description: Xray VLESS + Bun subscription server with 6-day Let's Encrypt IP certs and one-command UUID rotation

scripts.deploy:build: bun run build && scp -P ${VLESS_SSH_PORT:-65455} dist/vless-sub-server.js ${VLESS_SSH_TARGET:?set VLESS_SSH_TARGET=user@host}:/usr/local/bin/vless-sub-server.js && ssh -p ${VLESS_SSH_PORT:-65455} ${VLESS_SSH_TARGET} 'chown root:root /usr/local/bin/vless-sub-server.js && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/vless-sub-server.js && chown root:xray /usr/local/bin/.env && chmod 640 /usr/local/bin/.env && systemctl restart vless-sub'
